posts.text: 🚨 @JohnMorganESQ  shares his perspective on who really holds power in America, reflecting on Johnny Cochran’s belief that “the color of justice is green.” He also looks back on helping build Cochran’s law firm and explains why he views his role as protecting everyday people through the civil justice system. Check out the full interview on @netflix
